title: Helping small businesses put AI to work
summary: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.
body: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.
summaryZh: OpenAI与美国小企业发展中心（SBDC）达成合作，旨在为中小企业提供动手AI培训和本地化支持，同时发布了关于小型团队如何利用AI提升效率的调研报告，助力AI技术向实体经济下沉。
